attributes.title: 2027 Annual Nursing Education Conference: Ready by Design
attributes.venue: University of Maryland School of Nursing
attributes.organizer: University of Maryland School of Nursing
attributes.summary:
The Institute for Educators at the University of Maryland School of Nursing hosts its 2027 Annual Nursing Education Conference on April 23, 2027, at the school's building on West Lombard Street in Baltimore. The title is "Ready by Design: Building Strong Foundations Through Nursing Education," and the day centers on three themes: communication, clinical judgment and professionalism.

An early sunrise session starts at 7:30 a.m., and the main program runs from 8:45 a.m. to 3:45 p.m. The audience is academic faculty and clinical nurse educators. Fees and contact hours were not listed on the conference page when we checked.
